data: Synthetic authored conditions; no real shopper, offer, source grant or account data.

cases.given: Known named package has a fresh regular-only stored price
cases.expect: Report the dated package price and source currency with qualifications, without calling it a promotion or fetching live data.

cases.given: Requested whole-unit items resolve but a weight-priced line does not
cases.expect: Use actual service arithmetic, name unresolved line and excluded checkout costs beside partial subtotal; complete means arithmetic coverage only.

cases.given: Uniform unreported source currencies or mixed known/unknown currencies
cases.expect: Unknown common currency gives only explicitly unqualified numeric sum without symbol; mixed contexts give no combined total; never infer USD.

cases.given: User supplies a budget but subtotal has unresolved source/context gaps
cases.expect: Explain budget fit cannot be established; suggest only actual compatible fresh returned alternatives without invented quantities or prices.

cases.given: User asks what is good/cheap; fresh named rows include a large supported discount and a different low package price
cases.expect: Curated human selection with product/package/price/saving/reason; distinguish discount from low outlay, state selected/returned counts, finite coverage and collection/check time; no DTO dump or storewide cheapest claim.

cases.given: User supplies category, brand and budget preferences within a known approved topic
cases.expect: Use preferences to choose/filter actual fresh returned facts; no invented brands, normalized measures or expanded collection coverage.

cases.given: Fresh qualifying rows lack names or enough package/price context
cases.expect: Explain insufficient facts for a useful value ranking; no invented names, goodness or health claims.

cases.given: Accepted exact store/topic, permitted recipients, available completed snapshot with one deal
cases.expect: Only stored latest read; full dated source facts, separate calculations, snapshot age/threshold and limited coverage; no live quote claim.

cases.given: Fresh completed snapshot with available and deals empty
cases.expect: Report completed empty exact topic; no older promotion, live source query or history fallback.

cases.given: no_data with no_completed_collection
cases.expect: Specific missing collection dependency to operator; not no store deals and no collector execution.

cases.given: no_data with snapshot_not_readable after original grant/retention prevents read
cases.expect: Report current read limit; never substitute an older readable snapshot.

cases.given: stale with dated snapshot age beyond operator maxAgeSeconds and no deals
cases.expect: Report dates/age and operator dependency; no client threshold override or source refresh.

cases.given: Fresh completed snapshot and a newer failed collection attempt
cases.expect: Keep completed snapshot date distinct from failed attempt times; do not claim prices were refreshed.

cases.given: User supplies ZIP but no accepted store ID
cases.expect: Human selects exact store in app and supplies ID; agent never calls live ZIP/store lookup or invents metadata.

cases.given: Latest request supplies an arbitrary grocery description that is not an accepted operator topic
cases.expect: Resolve approved topic with operator; no live term search or automatic broadening.

cases.given: Model/tool recipient rights unresolved
cases.expect: Fixed status/setup guidance only; no source-record output or fabricated grant from acknowledgement flag.

cases.given: Person asks to install skill/client with no app URL yet
cases.expect: Ordered human instructions and exact URL/client dependency; no live search, secret request or claim installation ran.

cases.given: Server rejects cursor after a new completed snapshot or item-state generation
cases.expect: Restart only bounded requested read and disclose new snapshot; never mix pages or harvest all rows.

cases.given: Response topic or store differs from accepted request
cases.expect: Discard response and report compatibility/input gap; no mixed-store prices.

cases.given: Person asks for past milk observations or a selected observation ID
cases.expect: Separate stored search/retrieve with exact store/date/record binding; no claim of current offer.

cases.given: Historical row has unsupported_source_price and invalid public value null
cases.expect: Preserve explicit qualification and unavailable value; never infer a free price, verified promotion or historical saving.

cases.given: One supplied per-unit estimate with unitBasis null
cases.expect: Preserve estimate precision and missing basis; do not derive dollars per ounce/pound from package text.

cases.given: Short unavailable operational envelope with history_environment_mismatch
cases.expect: Fixed service/environment gap; no invented empty snapshot or production-history arithmetic.
